text:
tessa: FYI, after yesterday's coalesce tuning there's a recurring p99 for <12-token reqs. looks like interference from large prefetched joins.

omar: saw that on dashboards. p95 stable, p99 jumping ~25ms intermittently.

tessa: trace shows tiny reqs getting stuck behind a long join-chain when a big request lands in the same window.

vik: three low-risk mitigations we discussed: 1) rollback prefetch bump on tiny-shard, 2) implement lease_jitter to de-sync window edges, 3) add "soft-priority credits" so small routes get short-path wins.

rachel: can we do (2) + (3) in a canary first? credits are time-based refill (cheap) and jitter is micro-change. both should reduce pathological alignment without global rollback.

omar: agree on canary. also want extra metrics before/after: join_wait_by_size, slot_wins_by_priority, eviction_delta. add tenant and size_bucket labels.

canary-bot: canary cluster batcher-canary-3 ready. automated dashboards pre-seeded.

vik: plan: canary deploy credits+jitter to one shard, monitor 24h. if tiny p99 improves and eviction_delta < 5% we expand. otherwise rollback.

tessa: noted. who takes metrics PR and the admission change?

rachel: i'll open the metrics PR and the dashboard (WIP link to internal).

omar: i'll implement lease_jitter (few lines in admission timing) and wire a feature flag.

vik: credits prototype: refill 8 credits/sec, bucket=64, one credit lets a tiny request win a priority slot. I'll push proto to a feature branch and simulate with prod traces.

canary-bot: monitor configured: alert on tiny-p99 > baseline+10ms or eviction_delta > 5%.

tessa: timeline: deploy canary within 6h, collect 24h of data, decision next day. add sim runs in parallel.

rachel: metrics PR: https://git.internal/r/telemetry/pull/401 (WIP). will post dashboard link once ready.

vik: sim note: credits reduce tiny p99 by ~30% in traces where large request density is medium-high. auction-style slotting gave slightly better reduction but complexity cost is higher.

omar: okay let's proceed with canary credits+jitter. rollback plan is immediate if cascade effect on midsize latency shows.

tessa: thanks. keep updates here and drop any sim artifacts or run ids. :thumbsup:
